text:
Emma T.: Postmortem follow-up for Vesper dedicated outage. Short: intermittent VPC peering flaps from customer edge + an isolation-controller bug led to a broad tenant isolation. Impact ~4 hours degraded capacity. We need concrete owners, short ETAs, and a recurrence detector.

Emma T.: Proposed action items:
• Peering stabilisation (per-peer dampening, keepalive tuning) — owner/ETA?
• Isolation-controller patch (debounce + origin-AS/prefix sanity) — owner/ETA?
• Canary workflow for on-prem peering changes — owner/ETA?
• Runbook & smoke-test checklist pre/post-change — owner/ETA?
• Alerting: route-flap -> auto-ticket + pager for high impact customers — owner/ETA?

Rohan B.: I can own peering stabilisation. Plan: add dampening on Vesper neighbors, modest keepalive bump, and a peer-specific ACL. ETA: design + staging test in 7 days, staged rollout in 12 days.

Kara (runtime): I'll take the isolation-controller patch. Plan: 25s debounce on withdraws, require matching origin-AS for 60s, and emit isolation_decision metrics with tags. ETA: hotfix PR in 4 business days; canary in 9 days.

Jin (sre): I'll build the canary workflow and smoke tests. Suggest: synthetic /24, canary tenant, 30m traffic probe, validate KV cache & latency. ETA: harness + scripts in 5 days.

case-csm: I will coordinate with Vesper for a maintenance window and request BGP logs for verification. Can confirm slot by EOD tomorrow.

rdw-bot: Created Jira: RDW-2901 (vesper-peering-stabilize), RDW-2902 (isolation-controller-debounce), RDW-2903 (vesper-onprem-canary). Links: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2901 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2902 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2903

Rohan B.: Preflight (staging) snippet:
```
# check BGP neighbor state on staging-edge
ssh ops@staging-edge 'vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"'
```

Kara (runtime): Local sim for route churn (test-router):
```
# simulate transient withdraws
for i in 1 2 3; do ip route add 198.51.100.0/24 via 192.0.2.$i; sleep 15; ip route del 198.51.100.0/24; done
```

Jin (sre): Alert proposal: alert if >3 BGP resets for a peer in 10m OR >5 route changes for vesper-prefixes in 15m -> auto-open RDW incident and tag vesper. Add Grafana tile: vesper_peer_flaps_30d.

Emma T.: Prioritization: RDW-2902 (controller patch) = prio:critical, RDW-2901 = prio:high, RDW-2903 = prio:medium. Hotfix must land before any mass isolation-policy changes.

rdw-bot: Calendar invite "Vesper peering remediation sync" scheduled at 2278887200. Invitees: @Rohan B., @Kara (runtime), @Jin (sre), @case-csm, @Emma T.

Rohan B.: Note: avoid lowering global hold-times; prefer per-neighbor dampening and targeted keepalive increases.

Kara (runtime): agreed  debounce + origin checks first, then canary, then policy rollout.

Emma T.: Please confirm owners & ETAs here by EOD. If blockers, flag now.

Rohan B.: confirmed owner RDW-2901, ETA design+staging 7 days.

Kara (runtime): confirmed owner RDW-2902, ETA hotfix 4 business days.

Jin (sre): confirmed RDW-2903, ETA harness 5 days.

case-csm: will post maintenance window by tomorrow EOD to RDW-2903.

Emma T.: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem action list and add a monthly peering stability check for Vesper. If anything changes, update the Jira ticket and ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
